newsitem.title: CHINA: China to take 46 percent in 100-seat plane venture.
newsitem.headline: China to take 46 percent in 100-seat plane venture.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it was joining forces with a European aircraft consortium that includes British Aerospace and France's Aerospatiale to build a 100-seat airliner.

The official Xinhua news agency said Aviation Industries of China (AVIC) would take a 46 percent stake in the ambitious project, while the European consortium Aero International Asia would take 39 percent.
The remaining 15 percent would be taken by Singapore Technologies Aerospace, it said.
The Portuguese news agency Lusa reported that Aero International Asia had signed a $1.7 billion agreement with China.
The news emerged at a Chinese aviation show in Zhuhai near the Portuguese-administered territory of Macau, it said.
